remainingFamilies.rule: May remain deferred if the first Stage B slice does not depend on governed empty-state semantics.
Must be qualified before any Stage B slice that claims offline, degraded-connectivity or resilient continuity semantics.

requiredBeforeAuthorization: define one bounded first runtime adoption slice
declare target product and exact surface
declare which qualified patterns the slice consumes
declare whether offline/degraded continuity is in scope
if offline/degraded continuity is in scope, qualify TRAMA.OFFLINE_DEGRADED first
define rollback and observable success/failure criteria
define accessibility, responsive and perceptible-write acceptance checks
obtain independent review of the Stage B plan before runtime changes
forbidden: implicit normalization of Arena, Atlas, Docente OS and Control Center identities
runtime migration before a bounded Stage B slice is approved
using QUALIFIED as equivalent to STABLE
claiming offline resilience without a qualified OFFLINE_DEGRADED contract

recommendedNextAction.selectionRule: Prefer a low-blast-radius surface that already exhibits the qualified semantics, can be rolled back independently, preserves the product PVIP, and does not require OFFLINE_DEGRADED unless that family is qualified first.
